maya: Quick pilot idea Credit Delivery Test 90-seat cohort to compare one-shot credits vs drip credits, plus two prompt onboarding flows (Starter Pack vs Playground). Metric: week-1 activation. Thoughts? :seedling:

jamie: Yes. Split 45/45. One-shot = 80 credits upfront. Drip = 30 now, 30 at 48h, 20 on engagement. Templates orthogonal, randomize by cookie.

nate: Creative: hero + 20s clip. CTA variations: 'Claim credits' / 'Join office hours'. Assets EOD Mon.

leah: Ops: 3 office hours across regions. Email cadence: confirm, 48h nudge (drip note), 24h reminder. Post-webinar replay + credit reminder (expire 7d).

samir: Infra: pre-warm pool 20m before each slot. Cap GPUs=16, fallback to quantized variant at 80% util. Enable prefix caching for starter pack.

aj: Routing/events: tag utm=credit_delivery_test. If user >3 requests in 24h mark 'engaged' and auto-invite to office hours. I'll add analytics hooks.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale set project/credit-delivery (min=1,max=16). Alert rule: p95 latency > 600ms -> page.

maya: Action items: @aj implement tags + analytics, @samir infra pre-warm + fallback, @leah emails + reg flow, @nate creative. Quick sync Thu 9:30 to confirm readiness. Thanks! :tada:
